key.name: rules
key.description: JSON array of {"subnet":"CIDR","device":"iface"}. Each subnet is routed out the chosen network card while split routing is on. IPv4 and IPv6 subnets are both accepted. Ships empty; filled in from the settings UI.

key.name: default-device
key.description: Interface name of the card that should carry the default route while split routing is on. Empty means the default route is left untouched.

key.name: undo-record
key.description: JSON description of the runtime changes this extension actually made: per card, the routes it added and the previous never-default value it overwrote. Written by the extension after each change and used to undo exactly those changes, so routes and settings the user already had are never removed. Not meant to be edited by hand.
